process: g g > g g g g g QED=0 [virt=QCD]
name: gg_ggggg_njet
scheme_description: massless QCD: five massless quark flavours (u, d, s, c, b) in the loops and in the MS-bar running of alpha_s(mu_R); NO top quark (NJet has no massive quarks). pyAmpliCol's loop_sm (MT=173, top loops, top decoupled from alpha_s) differs from this only in the finite part; see comparison_rules.
source: NJet 3.1.2 (https://bitbucket.org/njet/njet, release tarball), numerical colour-summed Amp0q7g through NJetAccuracy, driver tools/loop_reference/njet/njet_driver.cpp; poles also from NJet 2.1.1's colour-correlated Borns and the Catani I operator
scope: Independent reference values at pyAmpliCol's exact g g > g g g g g points (points 0-2 are those of the work/v2-generation-scale campaign); no pyAmpliCol code involved.

evaluation_orientation.name: R1
evaluation_orientation.note: NJet evaluated at the exactly rotated points
evaluation_orientation.reason: NJet's numerics depend on the orientation of the event: at the points as given (beams along +-z) NJet 3.1.2 and 2.1.1 lose 4-6 digits in double precision (NaN at points 7-9) and the QCDLoop double-double mode is no better; at generic orientations the poles agree with the Catani prediction to <= 3e-9 in double. The virtual is a Lorentz scalar, so the values are those of the points as given.

convention: MadLoop/BLHA C_eps=(4pi)^eps/Gamma(1-eps); CDR/HV ('t Hooft-Veltman) with MS-bar alpha_s(mu_R); physical couplings g_s^2=4 pi alpha_s; initial spin and colour average and final identical-gluon factor 1/5!; the virtual is 2 Re<M0|M1>. This is the convention of every tests/fixtures/loop/required fixture (MadLoop, OpenLoops truepoles=1 polenorm=0, Recola +pi^2/6 D) and of pyAmpliCol (loops/v2/conventions.py); calibrated without any factor, see calibration.

point_construction.construction: tools/loop_reference/exact_points.generate([0]*7, count=10, cut=1/1000) (the generator and order of pyAmpliCol's loop_v2_generate/campaign)

comparison_rules.double_pole: direct (also for a bare virtual: counterterms and R2 have no 1/eps^2)
comparison_rules.single_pole: direct for a renormalised virtual; a bare loop_sm virtual is compared after subtracting (alpha_s/4pi) B [(n-2) beta_0(5) + (8/3) T_F] = (alpha_s/4pi) B (119/3) at n=7 (njet_fixture.bare_single_pole_shift)
comparison_rules.finite: only for a top-free pyAmpliCol configuration (record 'top_quark_loops': false); with loop_sm's top loops the difference is the top-loop contribution, reported, not tested

error_metric: |a-b|/max(|a|,|b|,|Born| alpha_s/(2pi)) for Laurent coefficients, |a-b|/max(|a|,|b|) for the Born (references.py merge metric); estimated_relative_accuracy = |NJet scaling-test difference| / max(|value|, |Born| alpha_s/(2pi))

rotation.note: NJet evaluated at the exactly rotated points

catani.tool: NJet 2.1.1 colour-correlated Born + Catani I operator
catani.formula: single = (alpha_s/2pi)[-n gamma_g B + sum_{i!=j} <T_i.T_j> log(mu^2/|2p_i.p_j|)], gamma_g = 11/6 C_A - 2/3 T_F n_f; double = -(alpha_s/2pi) n C_A B (run_njet.py catani)

providers.accuracy_estimate: NJet's scaling test (NJetAccuracy::virt): the amplitude is evaluated at the point and with all momenta (and mu_R) rescaled by 1.2857142857142855; the value is their average, the estimate their difference.
